text:
maria: quick dump from this morning's cross-GPU attention runs. TL;DR: H100 flash-v2 shows a regression at seq>=2048 + bsz>=4 (memcopy stalls), L40S paged/fused combo looks best for very long seqs but we hit KV-cache eviction thrash at 4096 that creates 2-3x latency variance. A100 is still stable with flash-v1 for most workloads. attaching short notes and commands below.

alex: can you paste the exact command + model/kernel build you used? also which kernel selector config? :eyes:

maria: sure — run used linux/runner:latest, kernels from build/attn/2026-03-18 (flash-v1, flash-v2, paged-fused). selector: runtime heuristics=v2 (seq/batch heatmap). command:

```bash
# simple repro loop (one GPU per job)
./bench_attn --model llama7b --kernel flash-v2,flash-v1,paged-fused \\n  --gpus A100,H100,L40S --seqs 128,512,1024,2048,4096,8192 \\n  --bsz 1,2,4,8 --iters 200 --kv-cache true --log perf_out.json
```

perf-bot: auto-summary: A100: flash-v1 best at seq<=1024 (latency median 12ms @ bsz=2). H100: flash-v2 wins for small seq but regresses at seq>=2048 bsz>=4 -> memcopy wait + kernel requeue observed. L40S: paged-fused best past 4096 but KV-eviction thrash (see var/p95 spikes). Full perf_out.json saved to s3://redwood-perf/1815004321/

sunil: do we know which eviction policy + kv bucket sizing you used? could be churn from tiny bucket count on L40S.

maria: default test config, kv_cache.max_items=1000000, eviction_policy=lru, kv_bucket_count=1024, batch_timeout_ms=3. patched kernel flags: PREFETCH=1, SPLIT_PAGED=0. snippet: 

```json
{
  "kv_cache": {"max_items": "1000000", "eviction": "lru", "bucket_count": "1024"},
  "batching": {"timeout_ms": "3", "max_batch": "8"}
}
```

jamie: fwiw i re-ran a cropped L40S case (seq=4096, bsz=4) and bumping batch_timeout_ms to 8 reduced the eviction churn but increased p95 by ~12% (tail shifted). tradeoff: less variance but higher tail. :thinking:

maria: that matches what i saw — tighter batching reduces p95 variance but hurts tail for latency-sensitive apps. for throughput-bound jobs increasing batch_timeout to 6-10ms is ok.

alex: i'll run a focused H100 job (seq 2048, 4096 x bsz 2/4/8) with batch_timeout=8 and memcopy tracing on (nvtx + cupti). will also capture host <-> gpu memcpy latencies via our memcpy-watcher. scheduling now.

perf-bot: scheduled benchmark job h100/replica-17 (id: perf-1815004321-1). will post baseline + traces when done. :party_parrot:

maria: follow-ups: 1) bisect flash-v2 changes between builds 2026-03-10..2026-03-18 for memcopy reorderings; 2) try kv_bucket_count=4096 on L40S + batch_timeout=6ms; 3) add a canary route using dedicated pool with pinned kernels (avoid selector fallback). can someone own 1 and 2?

alex: i can take 1 (bisect). i'll post commit ranges and a quick perf harness.

sunil: i'll own 2 and run the kv-bucket tuning matrix on L40S fleet (small matrix: bucket_count 1024/2048/4096 x timeout 3/6/8). will report p50/p95 and eviction rates.

maria: awesome. thanks. will re-run a consolidated report after those runs and open a perf bug if bisect points to a kernel regression.

jamie: if bisect shows kernel regression we should also test a staged rollback on canary dedicated to confirm impact on production workload traces.

maria: agreed. i'll draft the rollback playbook once we have bisect result.

alex: noted. starting bisect now. ping me if you need the short repro script.

perf-bot: will update thread with job completions + artifacts links.
